name: discover / read_layers

test_list.description: From a nested cwd, the nearest ancestor .polaris/ is the repo dir.
Without a .polaris/ ancestor the repo dir is None; the global dir is <home>/.polaris.
A UTF-8 BOM + CRLF config file parses; a missing file is not an error.
POLARIS_RATELIMIT__RPM=600 becomes ratelimit.rpm = 600; other variables are ignored.
SessionOverrides serialise to TOML and back unchanged (D11 resume).
A syntax error names the file and line.
The upward walk stops at home (exclusive): ~/.polaris is never the (untrusted) repo dir and directories above home are never projects.
POLARIS_A=1 together with POLARIS_A__B=2 is an Invalid error, never a silent drop.
Windows: a config file held open without sharing (editor/AV) is read after a bounded retry instead of failing.
A .polaris/ above a working directory whose path exceeds 260 characters is found (no MAX_PATH failure).

output_description: ~/.polaris and the nearest .polaris/, and the layers read from them.
